sources: trip_data/ridb_campsites.json (RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233442, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: Peak season (May 1-Sep 30, 2026, same in the 2027 table): $34 a night for a standard electric site, $68 for the double electric site; the $24 non-electric sites take tents, vans, pickup campers and pop-ups only, not RVs. America the Beautiful Senior/Access cardholders get 50% off camping fees. $7 day-use fee waived for campers.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442/rates (2026-05-01 to 2026-09-30 Peak Season: STANDARD ELECTRIC 34, double electric 68, STANDARD NONELECTRIC 24) + RIDB catalog (no non-electric site lists RV or trailer equipment), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The day-use park is open year-round.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442 (Overview: 'The campground is open May 1 - September 30. The Day Use Park is open year-around'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: RIDB campsite catalog for 233442 (all 11 STANDARD ELECTRIC sites: Electricity Hookup 50, Water Hookup Yes) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442 (amenities 'Electric Hookups', 'Water Hookups'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 21 sites: 11 shady electric sites (one a double; two paved and accessible) that take RVs and trailers, 23 to 40 ft (one pull-through, the rest back-in), and 10 small primitive sites in an open field for tents, vans, pickup campers and pop-ups.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442 ('The campground has 21 sites: 11 shady electric sites (1 is a double) and 10 primitive sites in an open field') + RIDB campsite catalog (Max Vehicle Length 23-40 on electric sites; Driveway Entry 1 Pull-through), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442 ('individual restrooms with hot showers, sink and flush toilets. Park has a small dump station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Maximum stay 14 days within any 30-day period (changing names or sites to exceed it is prohibited). Check-in 4 p.m., check-out 2 p.m.; reservations to the day of arrival (cut-off 0 days).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442 (notices 'Maximum stay is 14-days within any 30 day period'; facility_rules maxStay 14 nights Rolling 30 Days, reservationCutOff 0), read 2026-10-21

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233442 (notice: 'Golden Age/Access and America the Beautiful Interagency Senior and Access Passes are accepted at this campground and cardholders receive a 50% discount on camping fees'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Fees base changed $24-34 -> $34: the $24 non-electric sites take no RVs (RIDB equipment lists), so the RV base is the $34 electric site (double $68). Confirmed 50-amp + water (derived -> manual), Senior/Access 50% discount, rec.gov booking with 14-in-30 max; added season May 1-Sep 30, 21 sites (11 RV) to 40 ft with a pull-through, showers, flush toilets, dump.
